android.desc: Typing Hero helps businesses and professionals worldwide save 1.23M+ hours (14B+ keystrokes) Typing Hero lets you assign keyword to messages you type often. You can automatically insert date and time info in the template, or use Form to ask for input to complete the template. Typing Hero provides powerful text automation features that lets you perform actions such as selecting or transforming text, simple calculations, and more. Free features 🆓 Add up to 20 Snippets 🆓 Folder 🆓 Snippet Suggestion 🆓 Snippet Copier (via Quick Settings tile) 🆓 Insert current date & time 🆓 Snippet Reference (insert template from another Snippet) 🆓 Cursor placement (after replacing keyword) 🆓 Export as CSV 🆓 Import from Texpand 🆓 Import from TextExpander™️ Premium features 💎 Add unlimited Snippets 💎 Add multiple templates into one Snippet 💎 Automatic template selection for Multiple Templates Snippets: First, Random, Sequential 💎 Form (dialog to complete the template) 💎 Date Time Offset 💎 Date Ranges 💎 Simulate Enter/Return after replacing Keyword 💎 Automatically send template in supported chat apps 💎 Contact Integration 💎 Simple calculator 💎 Starting WhatsApp chat integration 💎 Text selection 💎 Text deletion 💎 Text transformation 💎 Cursor movement 💎 Clipboard History 💎 Automatic Backup & Restore Important ❗ Typing Hero uses accessibility service to detect keyword and click provide relevant functions ❗ All features requires Google Play Service ❗ Some apps are incompatible with Typing Hero on Android 12 or older (https://typinghero.app/docs/incompatible-apps) ❗ Contact Integration requires the read contact permission, requested only when used ❗ 2-weeks free trial with Monthly or Yearly Subscription ❗ One-time payment for Lifetime License is available Privacy policy: https://typinghero.app/privacy/ Documentation: https://typinghero.app/docs/ Contact: support@typinghero.app 🇮🇩 Made in Jakarta, Indonesia
